title: 34-year-old man feeling unwell
arrival: A 34-year-old man presents feeling unwell, with symptoms that began two hours ago.
feedbackWhy: His heart rate is above 150 bpm, which meets a red Circulation criterion. He looks well, but the measured heart rate decides the category, and he should be moved to the high acuity area immediately.
reviewNote: CLINICIAN REVIEW REQUIRED: every value in this draft is proposed and needs confirming, in particular HR 168 bpm with a regular pulse. The case info leaves out palpitations on purpose, so check that it is not misleading.

design.intendedChallenge: A patient who looks well can still meet a red criterion. A heart rate above 150 is found by measuring it, not by looking at the patient.
design.expectedCommonError: triaging him as yellow or green because he looks well.

airway_red.text: Speaks in full sentences. No stridor. No respiratory distress. No central cyanosis.

circulation_red.text: Pulse felt at the wrist and regular. Capillary refill 2 seconds. No bleeding.

disability_red.text: No convulsions. Alert with normal mental status. No headache. No stiff neck.

other_red.text: Age 34. No trauma, poisoning, threatened limb or snake bite. No chest or abdominal pain. Not aggressive.

airway_yellow.text: No swelling of the mouth, throat or neck. No wheezing.

circulation_yellow.text: No vomiting or diarrhoea. No ongoing bleeding. Not pale. No fainting. Drinking normally.

disability_yellow.text: Alert and calm. No weakness. No visual disturbance. No pain.

other_yellow.text: No rash, deformity, fracture or dislocation. No trauma. No known surgical diagnosis. Passing urine normally. No bite or needlestick exposure.
